Index: 
===================================================================
--- 
+++ 
@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+{
+  "manifest_version": 3,
+  "name": "Focus Blocker",
+  "description": "Blocks distracting websites while you should be focusing.",
+  "version": "0.1.0",
+
+  "permissions": [
+    "storage",
+    "declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess"
+  ],
+
+  "host_permissions": [
+    "*://*.youtube.com/*",
+    "*://youtube.com/*",
+
+    "*://*.instagram.com/*",
+    "*://instagram.com/*",
+
+    "*://*.netflix.com/*",
+    "*://netflix.com/*"
+  ],
+
+  "background": {
+    "service_worker": "src/background/service-worker.js",
+    "type": "module"
+  },
+
+  "action": {
+    "default_popup": "src/popup/popup.html"
+  },
+
+  "web_accessible_resources": [
+    {
+      "resources": [
+        "src/blocked/blocked.html",
+        "src/blocked/blocked.css"
+      ],
+      "matches": [
+        "<all_urls>"
+      ]
+    }
+  ]
+}
\ No newline at end of file
